_comment: Fixed text and contacts shown when the safety check fires. NEVER model-generated: a model must not invent emergency guidance for a child. Neel owns this file and verifies every number and URL against its official source before submission. Phone numbers here are long-standing German public services, but each still needs its source_url checked and the checked_on date updated.
_review_status: DRAFT - numbers are well known but not yet verified against official pages by a human. Do not ship or demo as verified until Neel sets _review_status to 'verified' and fills every source_url.

contacts.name: krisenchat
contacts.note: Text chat, so a child who cannot speak aloud can still reach a person.

danger.en: If someone can hurt you right now, call 110. You do not have to write anything else first.
danger.hi: अगर कोई अभी आपको चोट पहुँचा सकता है, तो 110 पर कॉल करें। पहले कुछ और लिखने की ज़रूरत नहीं है।
danger.de: Wenn dir gerade jemand wehtun kann, ruf 110 an. Du musst vorher nichts weiter schreiben.

self_harm.en: What you wrote sounds heavy. You can talk to someone right now at krisenchat.de, by text. You do not have to be in danger to write to them.
self_harm.hi: आपने जो लिखा वह भारी लगता है। आप अभी krisenchat.de पर किसी से बात कर सकते हैं, लिखकर। बात करने के लिए खतरे में होना ज़रूरी नहीं है।
self_harm.de: Was du geschrieben hast, klingt schwer. Du kannst gerade jetzt mit jemandem schreiben, auf krisenchat.de. Du musst nicht in Gefahr sein, um dort zu schreiben.

ui_always_visible._comment: The real safety net is not detection. Help must be reachable on every screen whether or not the check fires, including when it fails.
